title: S06T05 - Complete adapter lifecycle, compatibility matrix, and clean-machine fixtures
description: Unify install, update, migration, validation, removal, profile switching, and documentation across all supported targets and operating systems.
acceptanceCriteria: A published compatibility matrix reports target version, supported capabilities, install roots, tested platforms, and known limitations.
Clean-machine fixtures validate every adapter without relying on the Boreal source checkout or another repository's assets.
All repository changes are captured in one or more scoped Git checkpoint commits, or closeout records an accepted no-repo-changes reason.
Relevant automated tests, documentation checks, and strict Boreal health checks pass before closeout.
